'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[Gaza war]]
***[[Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip]]
****[[October 2024 Beit Lahia attacks]]
*****[[Hamas]] reports that the number of dead and missing following an Israeli bombardment of residential areas in [[North Gaza Governorate|northern Gaza]] yesterday increases to 87, becoming among the [[List of Israeli massacres in Gaza 2023–2024|highest single-incident death tolls]] in the past few months and also prompting condemnation from the [[United Nations]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/un-condemns-israeli-airstrikes-gazas-beit-lahiya-2024-10-20/ (Reuters)]
****[[Siege of Jabalia]]
*****The [[Israel Defense Forces]] announce that Colonel [[Ehsan Daxa]], the commander of the [[401st Brigade (Israel)|401st Armored Brigade]], was killed by an [[Improvised explosive device|IED]] in [[Jabalia]] in northern Gaza, becoming one of the most senior officers to have been killed in the fighting in Gaza. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/idf-commander-of-401st-armored-brigade-killed-in-battle-in-northern-gaza/#openwebComments (''The Times of Israel'')]
**[[2024 Iran–Israel conflict]]
***[[2024 leak of U.S. intelligence on Israeli strike plans|Israeli retaliation leak]]
****Two confidential [[United States Intelligence Community|U.S. intelligence]] documents are leaked to a pro-[[Iran]]ian [[Telegram (software)|Telegram]] channel. The documents contain military assessments describing the detailed preparation of [[Israel]]'s [[October 2024 Iranian strikes on Israel|retaliatory attacks]] against Iran for striking Israel. [https://www.npr.org/2024/10/19/g-s1-29081/us-investigating-unauthorized-release-classified-documents-israel-attack-plans (NPR)]
**[[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
***[[2024 Lebanon war]]
****[[2024 Israeli invasion of Lebanon]]
*****[[Israeli Ground Forces|Israeli troops]] open fire on a truck belonging to the [[Lebanese Armed Forces]] near [[Hanine]], killing three soldiers. Israel later issues a formal apology for the attack, stating that its forces mistakenly believed they were targeting a vehicle used by [[Hezbollah]] to transport rockets. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/idf-apologizes-for-strike-that-killed-3-lebanese-soldiers-says-troops-believed-they-were-targeting-hezbollah/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Battle of Khartoum (2023–2025)|Battle of Khartoum]], [[Famine in Sudan (2024–present)|Sudan famine]]
***The ''[[Sudan Tribune]]'' reports [[disease outbreak]]s and [[starvation]] in [[Khartoum North]], [[Sudan]], as a military offensive and fighting continues in the city. [https://sudantribune.com/article292241/ (''Sudan Tribune'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Atlantic hurricane season]]
**[[Hurricane Oscar (2024)|Hurricane Oscar]] makes landfall in [[Cuba]] amid a [[2024 Cuba blackout|national electrical blackout]]. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/weather/2024/10/20/storm-tracker-hurricane-oscar-path-spaghetti-models/75763514007/ (USA Today)]
*At least two people are killed and 309 others are rescued in [[flash flood]]ing in [[Roswell, New Mexico|Roswell]], [[New Mexico]], [[United States]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2024/10/20/us/new-mexico-flooding.html (''The New York Times'')] [https://www.nbcnews.com/weather/floods/2-dead-309-people-rescued-severe-flooding-new-mexico-rcna176318 (NBC News)]
*Four people are killed when a [[helicopter]] crashes into a [[radio tower]] in [[Houston]], [[Texas]], United States. [https://abcnews.go.com/amp/US/helicopter-crashes-radio-tower-houston/story?id=114977337 (ABC News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 Moldovan presidential election]], [[2024 Moldovan European Union membership referendum]]
**[[Moldovans]] vote for a [[President of Moldova|president]] and also vote in a [[referendum]] that would amend the [[Constitution of Moldova (1994)|constitution]] to include a commitment for [[Moldova]] to join the [[European Union]]. [https://www.lemonde.fr/en/international/article/2024/10/20/moldova-votes-to-confirm-or-reject-its-european-path_6729911_4.html (''Le Monde'')]
**The presidential election goes to a second-round between current president [[Maia Sandu]] and politician [[Alexandr Stoianoglo]] of the pro-Russian [[Party of Socialists of the Republic of Moldova|Party of Socialists]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c1wnr5qdxe7o (BBC)]
**The European Union referendum is narrowly approved by voters, with president Maia Sandu alleging [[foreign electoral intervention]] from [[Russian involvement in regime change#2023: Moldova|Russia]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/moldovas-eu-referendum-goes-wire-after-sandu-decries-vote-meddling-2024-10-21/ (Reuters)]
*[[Inauguration of Prabowo Subianto]]
**[[Prabowo Subianto]] and [[Gibran Rakabuming Raka]] are inaugurated as the 8th [[president of Indonesia|president]] and 14th [[vice president of Indonesia]], respectively. [https://apnews.com/article/indonesia-new-president-prabowo-subianto-sworn-44f1cb606ab8aa825b20b7f154ba9721 (AP)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/former-special-forces-commander-prabowo-take-up-indonesian-presidency-2024-10-19/ (Reuters)]
